sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "username" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, "password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("role" IN ('admin', 'receptionist')), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "must_change_password" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("must_change_password" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bed_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "price_per_block" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("price_per_block" > 0), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rooms" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "room_number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "floor" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "beds" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "room_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id), "label" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("label" IN ('A', 'B')), "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bed_categories (id), "cleanliness" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("cleanliness" IN ('clean', 'not_cleaned')), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("room_id", "label"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "housekeepers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "guests" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE, "id_type" TEXT NULL CHECK("id_type" IN ('national_id', 'passport', 'alien_id')), "id_number" TEXT COLLATE NOCASE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id_number IS NULL OR id_type IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shifts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "opened_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_float" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("opening_float" >= 0), "closed_at" TEXT NULL, "expected_cash" INTEGER NULL, "expected_paybill" INTEGER NULL, "counted_cash" INTEGER NULL, "variance" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('open', 'closed')), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((status = 'open') = (closed_at IS NULL)), CHECK (status = 'open' OR (expected_cash IS NOT NULL AND expected_paybill IS NOT NULL AND counted_cash IS NOT NULL AND variance IS NOT NULL AND variance = counted_cash - expected_cash)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stays" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "guest_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES guests (id), "bed_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beds (id), "check_in_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid_until" TEXT NOT NULL, "checked_out_at" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('active', 'closed')), "checked_in_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "checked_out_by" TEXT NULL REFERENCES users (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((status = 'active') = (checked_out_at IS NULL)), CHECK ((status = 'active') = (checked_out_by IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "shift_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "received_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "received_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount" > 0), "method" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("method" IN ('cash', 'paybill')), "mpesa_code" TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, "print_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((method = 'paybill') = (mpesa_code IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stay_charges" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "stay_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stays (id), "payment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payments (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('check_in', 'renewal')), "blocks" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("blocks" >= 1), "price_per_block" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("price_per_block" > 0), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "period_start" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_end" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount = blocks * price_per_block), CHECK (period_end > period_start));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "housekeeping_tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bed_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beds (id), "housekeeper_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES housekeepers (id), "assigned_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "assigned_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "completed_by" TEXT NULL REFERENCES users (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((completed_at IS NULL) = (completed_by IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "low_stock_level" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("low_stock_level" >= 0), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_items (id), "direction" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("direction" IN ('in', 'out')), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("quantity" > 0), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "recorded_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "voids" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("target_type" IN ('payment', 'stay')), "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(TRIM("reason")) > 0), "voided_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "voided_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("target_type", "target_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("category" IN ('laundry', 'utilities', 'wages', 'supplies', 'repairs', 'other')), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount" > 0), "spent_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "recorded_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (spent_on GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-1][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "before_json" TEXT NULL, "after_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "table_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "sent_at" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_counter" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES device (device_id), "next_number" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("next_number" >= 1), PRIMARY KEY ("device_id"));
CREATE INDEX guests_phone ON guests (phone)
CREATE INDEX guests_id_number ON guests (id_number)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX guests_id_unique ON guests (id_type, id_number) WHERE id_number IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX shifts_one_open_per_device ON shifts (device_id) WHERE status = 'open'
CREATE INDEX stays_guest ON stays (guest_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX stays_one_active_per_bed ON stays (bed_id) WHERE status = 'active'
CREATE INDEX payments_shift ON payments (shift_id)
CREATE INDEX stay_charges_stay ON stay_charges (stay_id)
CREATE INDEX stay_charges_payment ON stay_charges (payment_id)
CREATE INDEX housekeeping_tasks_bed ON housekeeping_tasks (bed_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX housekeeping_tasks_one_open_per_bed ON housekeeping_tasks (bed_id) WHERE completed_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX inventory_movements_item ON inventory_movements (item_id)
CREATE INDEX audit_log_at ON audit_log (at)
CREATE INDEX audit_log_user ON audit_log (user_id)
CREATE INDEX audit_log_action ON audit_log ("action")
CREATE INDEX audit_log_entity ON audit_log (entity, entity_id)
CREATE INDEX outbox_unsent ON outbox (seq) WHERE sent_at IS NULL
